summary: Derived two bounded author candidates pending distinct review. Candidate1 proves the exact sifted Vaughan convolution and both prime-power corrections, retains partial/positive endpoints, and derives rectangular Mobius and c_V0 coefficients with controlled product strips, common Mellin phases, unit removal and an explicit comparable-threshold extension of the actually reviewed ENERGY012 proof. Candidate2 proves reflected even-H TypeI relative to the inspected endpoint-uniform Mobius BV statement: finite Taylor/Bonferroni positive remainders and every plus-one count, g extraction, arbitrary supported b powers, the reduced odd class2qr/g, g-specific Y0 scales and tau-weighted BV at the19/40 versus2/5 margin, separate large-b reciprocal/endpoint Rankin tails, and endpoint log-k partial summation. No full primorial is a BV modulus and no extraneous gcd(g,db) is imposed. Assembly with accepted PAIRING011 and reviewed ENERGY012 gives the proposed weighted-prime consequence subject to this stage's review, with its general-H selected-strip or classical small-radical condition and explicit precision order. The target still contains W. No unweighted prime, polynomial-rough, Goldbach or novelty conclusion is obtained. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: The exact sifted Vaughan identity, two prime-power corrections and rectangle/Mellin interface produce the stated arithmetic coefficient roles and endpoint-uniform error bounds.
Relative to the precisely inspected Mobius BV input, the finite expansions, gcd extraction, reduced parity class and head/tail estimates give the stated endpoint-uniform even-H TypeI saving.
Restricting the smooth-power b expansion to squarefree b, imposing gcd(g,db)=1, omitting parity, or retaining only one prime-power correction are refuted variants with the displayed finite witnesses.

The displayed marked-prime consequence follows from these candidates and the reviewed pairing/energy dependencies with the explicit threshold, phase and precision checks, under the selected general-H strip or on the classical small-radical class, pending this stage's review.
Removal of W, actual unweighted prime cancellation, polynomial-rough/h1/nonzero-center margins, novelty and Goldbach remain unestablished.
